_doc: Motion-gate error budget + workspace config (crucible DESIGN §2.4). The hard margin is the SUM of margin_budget_mm terms — never a guess. Every term states its provenance; terms marked estimate are shadow mode's job to replace with measurements (steps 3-4). sweep_upper_bound uses levers from so101_spheres.json (amendment 9.1.8: derived from artifacts, not prose).

encoder_quantization.provenance: measured: 4096 ticks/360deg = 0.088 deg x 7.79 mm/deg worst lever (RESEARCH Q2 lever table)

backlash.provenance: estimate: +/-0.5 deg gear backlash x worst lever; SHADOW-MEASURE on this arm (step 4)

tracking_overshoot.provenance: estimate: servo tracking lag at demo GOAL_SPEED; SHADOW-MEASURE via Present_Position trace (step 4). The gate certifies commands, physics lags — this term is that gap's budget (Temper #9).

calibration_homing.provenance: estimate until commissioning residuals exist (amendment 9.1.9 / 10.1.7): bounded by the multi-pose suite's measured tool-height residuals in step 3

sphere_fit_residual.provenance: zero by construction: spheres CONTAIN the densified surface (max-radius rule + 1.5 mm edge inflation, verified by test_mesh_containment_100_percent) — the fit errs conservative, never optimistic

sampling.provenance: derived: half the max inter-sample sweep; the gate samples so that sweep <= 2 x this term via sum(|dtheta_j| x lever_j) (amendment 10.1.3)

_soft_band_provenance: anchored on the HOME pose: sphere over-approximation reads base|upper_arm at ~24.5 mm there (true mesh clearance is larger); soft threshold = 10.7 hard + 10 = 20.7 mm keeps home CLEAR while still speed-scaling genuine approaches. Shadow mode (step 4) re-tunes on the false-positive log.

table._exempt_reason: base_link is bolted to the table (straddles the plane by construction); shoulder_link's only DOF is shoulder_pan about the vertical axis, so its table clearance is pose-INVARIANT (~+6 mm static gap) — it cannot move into the table
table._metrology_note: height_m null = derive v0 from the spheres artifact's base_min_z_m (the base mesh's lowest point = the surface it stands on; the URDF origin is NOT the tabletop). Amendment 10.1.8: replace with tool-tip touch-test at 3 points during the step-3 calibration session; invalidated whenever the base moves.
